STLD.description: Static Load Case (STLD). Defines a static load case identified by a unique NAME and a load-case TYPE code; the record is keyed by its integer id.

NO.description: Load case id / ordering index as stored in the model. Read-only: set from the request key on write and echoed on read; the value in the body is ignored.

NAME.description: Static load case name. Must be unique across all static load cases (duplicate names are rejected at runtime).

TYPE.description: Static load case type code. Case-insensitive. USER=User Defined, D=Dead Load, DC=Dead Load of Component, DW=Dead Load of Wearing Surfaces and Utilities, DD=Downdrag, EP=Earth Pressure, EANN/EANC/EAMN/EAMC/EPNN/EPNC/EPMN/EPMC=Earthquake variants, EH=Horizontal Earth Pressure, EV=Vertical Earth Pressure, ES=Earth Surcharge, EL=Miscellaneous Locked-in Force, LS=Live Load Surcharge, LSC=Construction Live Load, L=Live Load, LC=Construction Load, LP=Pedestrian Live Load, IL=Impact Load, ILP=Impact Load for Pedestrian, CF=Centrifugal Force, BRK=Braking Force, BK=Breaking Force, CRL=Crane Load, PS=Prestress, B=Buoyancy, WP=Water Pressure, FP=Fluid Pressure, SF=Stream Flow Pressure, WPR=Water Pressure on Retaining, W=Wind Load, WL=Wind on Live Load, STL=Settlement, CR=Creep, SH=Shrinkage, T=Temperature, TPG=Temperature Gradient, CO=Collision, CT=Vehicular Collision Force, CV=Vessel Collision Force, E=Erection Load, FR=Friction, IP=Ice Pressure, CS=Construction Stage, ER=Erection, RS=Rib Shortening, GE=General, LR=Roof Live Load, S=Snow Load, R=Rain Load, LF=Longitudinal Force, RF=Rail Force, GD=Grade, SHV=Shear, DRL=Derailment, WA=Water Load, WT=Wind on Temperature, EVT=Event, EEP=Extreme Earth Pressure, EX=Explosion, I=Impact, EE=Extreme Event.

DESC.description: Free-text description of the load case.
